lc_person: Paul Miller-Melamed, formerly Paul B. Miller, born 1964; historian of modern Europe, author of From Revolutionaries to Citizens and Misfire, and co-editor of Embers of Empire.
item_person: Paul Miller / Paul B. Miller, born 1964; the same historian, with Paul Miller-Melamed recorded among the French and Czech aliases.

evidence.says: Authorized heading: Miller-Melamed, Paul, 1964-. Earlier established form: Miller, Paul B., 1964-. An October 2022 author email confirms permanent use of the hyphenated surname. A June 2014 author communication supports birth year 1964. Source notes identify From Revolutionaries to Citizens, Misfire, and Embers of Empire; identifiers include VIAF 33803932, GND 1063982944 and ISNI 0000000038118806.

Labels include Paul Miller, Paul B. Miller and Paul Brian Miller; French and Czech aliases include Paul Miller-Melamed. Birth year is 1964. P244 is n2001044680, and VIAF 33803932, GND 1063982944 and ISNI 0000000038118806 all match LC.
The key-evidence author record is named Paul Miller and explicitly marked undifferentiated; it cannot independently identify a single person.
Embers of Empire is linked to author OL292666A; its description concerns continuity between the Habsburg Empire and its successor states, matching the volume LC attributes to Miller-Melamed.

Embers of Empire: Continuity and Rupture in the Habsburg Successor States after 1918 is edited by Paul Miller and Claire Morelon. The editor biography identifies Miller as a history teacher at John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin and McDaniel College, and the author of Misfire.

Misfire (2022) is by Paul Miller-Melamed, Professor of History at John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin and McDaniel College, corroborating the connection between the two name forms and LC-listed works.

notes: The name disagreement reflects a documented surname change. The graph label and matching Embers of Empire work support the LC assignment, but Open Library OL292666A is undifferentiated and should not be treated as an exclusive identifier for this historian.
